title: Makeup Product Open-to-Finish Rate
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beauty:product category=* finished=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(finished="yes",1,0))) as matched by category
| eval a_finished_product_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_finished_product_pct
description: Measures the percentage of opened beauty products that end with a finished product by category.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which category are helping or hurting opened beauty products.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a finished product` on `beauty:product` events and summarize the hit rate by `category`.
visualization: Table of category with percentage of opened beauty products ending with a finished product.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how often a finished product happens for each category so you can see where opened beauty products go smoothly or get stuck.
